checks.statement: Use standard groups for coordinated shape/width interaction; use connected groups for related selectable options, and replace baseline segmented buttons with connected groups in M3 Expressive.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Button groups guidance.

evidence.result: Generation exposes standard and connected group controls; the catalog uses label/action buttons for standard and selectable buttons for connected.

implementation.notes: Generation exposes standard and connected group controls; the catalog uses label/action buttons for standard and selectable buttons for connected.

checks.statement: Standard groups are available in M3 Expressive only; connected groups are available in baseline M3 as segmented buttons and in M3 Expressive as connected groups.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Variants guidance.

evidence.result: The component matrix generates both standard and connected controls, and separate segmented-button family remains available for the baseline pattern.

implementation.notes: The component matrix generates both standard and connected controls, and separate segmented-button family remains available for the baseline pattern.

checks.statement: Keep standard-group buttons the same size and shape by default; reserve mixed sizes for hero moments and shape differences for selection, meaning, or contrast.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: All preview children receive the group size and a round shape, but no actual width/shape values are evaluated for a hero exception or product-specific meaning.

implementation.notes: All preview children receive the group size and a round shape, but no actual width/shape values are evaluated for a hero exception or product-specific meaning.

checks.statement: Use connected groups for related single- or multi-select toggle options; avoid them when no button can be selected, and do not mix color styles within a connected group.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: Connected preview uses toggle button attributes and implements single-selection state; each group uses one shared variant, preventing mixed styles in this renderer.

implementation.notes: Connected preview uses toggle button attributes and implements single-selection state; each group uses one shared variant, preventing mixed styles in this renderer.

checks.statement: Let standard groups hug their buttons with inner spacing; let connected groups span their surface, with a maximum width considered on large windows.
checks.condition: When laying out the group container.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container guidance.

evidence.result: Connected groups fill their surface within a 40rem renderer cap and distribute width across buttons. Standard groups hug content. Groups have one roving Tab entry and arrow traversal skips unavailable controls.
Node regression verifies the sole Tab stop and disabled-item filtering.
Chromium: 13 assertions pass for standard/connected groups, wrapping, disabled filtering, RTL and connected surface width.

fixes.summary: Keep one keyboard entry in button groups and fill connected surfaces

checks.statement: Keep a button group on one line across layouts; adjust size, width, or padding by breakpoint and preserve primary-action hierarchy.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing guidance.

evidence.result: Group is inline-flex with max-content width and no wrapping rule, so the group remains one line in its containing block.

implementation.notes: Group is inline-flex with max-content width and no wrapping rule, so the group remains one line in its containing block.

checks.statement: At smaller breakpoints, trailing group buttons may collapse into an overflow menu placed at the group’s trailing end; buttons outside the group do not participate.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Presentation guidance.

evidence.result: No responsive-overflow mode is configured. The captured requirement describes where to place overflow when that optional mode is used.

implementation.notes: No responsive-overflow mode is configured. The captured requirement describes where to place overflow when that optional mode is used.

checks.statement: Keep every button target at least 48×48dp; preserve the additional inner padding used by XS and S groups.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Interaction & style guidance.

evidence.result: XS/S connected groups add 48px min height/width targets while preserving smaller token button height; group sizes are generated for all five sizes.

implementation.notes: XS/S connected groups add 48px min height/width targets while preserving smaller token button height; group sizes are generated for all five sizes.

checks.statement: Do not focus the container; Tab enters on the first button, arrow keys move among items, and Space or Enter activates the focused button.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus guidance.

evidence.result: Connected groups fill their surface within a 40rem renderer cap and distribute width across buttons. Standard groups hug content. Groups have one roving Tab entry and arrow traversal skips unavailable controls.
Node regression verifies the sole Tab stop and disabled-item filtering.
Chromium: 13 assertions pass for standard/connected groups, wrapping, disabled filtering, RTL and connected surface width.

fixes.summary: Keep one keyboard entry in button groups and fill connected surfaces

checks.statement: Button groups support button sizes XS, S, M, L, and XL.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Button groups instructions.

evidence.result: Generated cases and token selector cover xsmall through xlarge and pass the selected size to each child button.

implementation.notes: Generated cases and token selector cover xsmall through xlarge and pass the selected size to each child button.

checks.statement: Support single-select, multi-select, and selection-required group patterns.
checks.condition: When a group represents selectable options.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Button groups instructions.

evidence.result: Single selection is implemented; multiple-selection toggles use shared button behavior, but selection-required group semantics are not represented by a distinct group mode in this runtime.

implementation.notes: Single selection is implemented; multiple-selection toggles use shared button behavior, but selection-required group semantics are not represented by a distinct group mode in this runtime.

checks.statement: XS through XL sizes and round or square default shapes are available in M3 Expressive; baseline M3 exposes selection patterns through segmented buttons but does not list these group sizes or shapes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Configurations instructions.

evidence.result: The generator creates all five sizes for standard/connected controls and single/multiple connected shapes; baseline segmented buttons are a separate generated family.

implementation.notes: The generator creates all five sizes for standard/connected controls and single/multiple connected shapes; baseline segmented buttons are a separate generated family.

checks.statement: Single-select, multi-select, and selection-required modes are supported in M3 Expressive; baseline M3 exposes these through segmented buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Configurations instructions.

evidence.result: Connected single/multiple are generated and single selection is handled; selection-required is not a separate runtime/configuration mode.

implementation.notes: Connected single/multiple are generated and single selection is handled; selection-required is not a separate runtime/configuration mode.

checks.statement: The extra-small standard group has a 32dp container height and 18dp spacing between buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Tokens & specs instructions.

evidence.result: Standard group height and gap are token-bound through variables, but resolved 32dp and 18dp values are not visible in these authored rules; inspect generated token resolution.

implementation.notes: Standard group height and gap are token-bound through variables, but resolved 32dp and 18dp values are not visible in these authored rules; inspect generated token resolution.

checks.statement: Treat the group as an invisible container that provides spacing and shape interaction; it contains no buttons by default.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Anatomy instructions.

evidence.result: Group container itself has no visible background/border and uses layout/gap styling; the catalog populates it with buttons as a preview.

implementation.notes: Group container itself has no visible background/border and uses layout/gap styling; the catalog populates it with buttons as a preview.

checks.statement: Button groups have no color of their own; use filled, tonal, outlined, or elevated button styles, and avoid standard icon buttons or text buttons without container treatment.
checks.condition: When styling buttons inside a group.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Group children are rendered as matching button variants, but the generator matrix lists only filled/tonal/outlined/elevated, and does not establish integration behavior for icon/text buttons.

implementation.notes: Group children are rendered as matching button variants, but the generator matrix lists only filled/tonal/outlined/elevated, and does not establish integration behavior for icon/text buttons.

checks.statement: When a standard-group button is pressed, change its width and shape along with adjacent buttons; a selected toggle button also changes between round and square and uses the corresponding button color.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Standard button group instructions.

evidence.result: Shared button behavior computes neighbor width compression for buttons in standard groups and triggers the transition when a group button is pressed.

implementation.notes: Shared button behavior computes neighbor width compression for buttons in standard groups and triggers the transition when a group button is pressed.

checks.statement: When a connected-group button is selected, change only its shape; do not change adjacent buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Connected button group instructions.

evidence.result: Connected single-mode click updates aria-pressed on siblings; connected styling changes selected inner radius on the selected button only.

implementation.notes: Connected single-mode click updates aria-pressed on siblings; connected styling changes selected inner radius on the selected button only.

checks.statement: Use inner spacing of 18dp for XS, 12dp for S, and 8dp for M, L, and XL standard groups.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Standard button group instructions.

evidence.result: Group gap is token-bound, but exact 18/12/8dp values for size categories are not readable in the authored CSS; needs resolved token check.

implementation.notes: Group gap is token-bound, but exact 18/12/8dp values for size categories are not readable in the authored CSS; needs resolved token check.

checks.statement: Use 2dp inner padding for connected groups at every size. Round groups have fully round outer corners and square inner corners of 4dp (XS), 8dp (S/M), 16dp (L), and 20dp (XL); square-group outer corners use those same size-specific values.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Connected button group instructions.

evidence.result: Inner/outer and selected/pressed corner radii are token-bound and CSS applies first/last corner rules; actual 2dp and size-specific radius values require resolved token inspection.

implementation.notes: Inner/outer and selected/pressed corner radii are token-bound and CSS applies first/last corner rules; actual 2dp and size-specific radius values require resolved token inspection.

checks.statement: Keep XS and S connected groups at least 48dp wide and provide 48×48dp target areas.
checks.condition: For XS and S connected groups.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Minimum widths instructions.

evidence.result: XS/S connected groups set minimum group/button inline size and generated pseudo target to space600.

implementation.notes: XS/S connected groups set minimum group/button inline size and generated pseudo target to space600.

checks.statement: Let group height adapt to the density setting applied to the buttons inside.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Density instructions.

evidence.result: Group buttons take their height from token-derived group height; child button size/state is retained, so density-specific button values can drive group height.

implementation.notes: Group buttons take their height from token-derived group height; child button size/state is retained, so density-specific button values can drive group height.

checks.statement: In a standard group, selection changes the selected button’s shape and width, changes a selected toggle button’s color, and temporarily adjusts adjacent-button width.
checks.condition: When a standard-group button is selected.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: Standard group pressed interactions use neighbor width compression; selected button uses selected shape/color custom properties in shared button styles.

implementation.notes: Standard group pressed interactions use neighbor width compression; selected button uses selected shape/color custom properties in shared button styles.

checks.statement: Use connected groups for related selectable actions, view switching, or sorting; require toggle selection and do not use a connected group if no button can be selected.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: Connected variant creates selectable toggle buttons, and single mode updates the selected item on activation.

implementation.notes: Connected variant creates selectable toggle buttons, and single mode updates the selected item on activation.

checks.statement: Keep color styles consistent across buttons in a connected group so selection and emphasis remain clear.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Every button receives the same `c.Variant` when built by the group helper, so this renderer does not mix color styles within a group.

implementation.notes: Every button receives the same `c.Variant` when built by the group helper, so this renderer does not mix color styles within a group.

checks.statement: Let connected groups span the page or surface and grow their buttons; consider a maximum width in larger windows.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Connected groups fill their surface within a 40rem renderer cap and distribute width across buttons. Standard groups hug content. Groups have one roving Tab entry and arrow traversal skips unavailable controls.
Node regression verifies the sole Tab stop and disabled-item filtering.
Chromium: 13 assertions pass for standard/connected groups, wrapping, disabled filtering, RTL and connected surface width.

fixes.summary: Keep one keyboard entry in button groups and fill connected surfaces

checks.statement: For fixed resizing, define width, size, or padding at each breakpoint; for flexible resizing, let button/group widths change until flexible buttons reach their maximum width.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: Group uses a content-sized inline-flex and token-derived button sizing with no breakpoint-specific fixed/flexible width or maximum-width logic.

implementation.notes: Group uses a content-sized inline-flex and token-derived button sizing with no breakpoint-specific fixed/flexible width or maximum-width logic.

checks.statement: Consider narrower, smaller buttons on compact windows and wider, larger buttons on large windows; preserve action hierarchy at every breakpoint and do not stretch icon buttons past wide.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: No group breakpoint styles change button widths or sizes; no icon-button-specific max-width behavior exists in this group stylesheet.

implementation.notes: No group breakpoint styles change button widths or sizes; no icon-button-specific max-width behavior exists in this group stylesheet.

checks.statement: On press, change the pressed button’s width and shape; adjacent widths also change in a standard group, while only the pressed button’s shape changes in a connected group.
checks.condition: When a group button is pressed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Pressed instructions.

evidence.result: Standard groups adjust pressed-item and neighboring widths; connected groups apply pressed inner shape only to the pressed button.

implementation.notes: Standard groups adjust pressed-item and neighboring widths; connected groups apply pressed inner shape only to the pressed button.

checks.statement: Change a selected button’s shape from round to square or square to round.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Selected instructions.

evidence.result: Selection toggles aria-pressed and connected CSS derives its current inner radius from selected state; standard button styles supply selected shape mappings.

implementation.notes: Selection toggles aria-pressed and connected CSS derives its current inner radius from selected state; standard button styles supply selected shape mappings.

checks.statement: Let assistive technology users navigate to and interact with every button and identify selected buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Group has role=group and accessible name; child native buttons expose aria-pressed for connected selection, with each action reachable.

implementation.notes: Group has role=group and accessible name; child native buttons expose aria-pressed for connected selection, with each action reachable.

checks.statement: The container does not need a label; label each button using the applicable button or icon-button accessibility guidance.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements instructions.

evidence.result: Container is named as Actions and each button has visible text labels (Back/Edit/Next or First/Second/Third).

implementation.notes: Container is named as Actions and each button has visible text labels (Back/Edit/Next or First/Second/Third).

checks.statement: When a standard-group button is selected or activated, change its padding along with its width and shape; this interaction adjusts the width of directly adjacent buttons.
checks.condition: For selection or activation in a standard button group.
checks.notes: The specs explicitly add selected-button padding changes alongside width/shape changes; standard-selection-motion covers the selected shape and adjacent-width response, and connected-selection-isolated covers connected-group behavior.

sourceHistory.summary: The specs explicitly add selected-button padding changes alongside width/shape changes; standard-selection-motion covers the selected shape and adjacent-width response, and connected-selection-isolated covers connected-group behavior.

evidence.result: Width and neighboring compression is implemented for standard groups; there is no explicit padding adjustment in group styles, and shared button width animation does not itself show selected padding changes.

implementation.notes: Width and neighboring compression is implemented for standard groups; there is no explicit padding adjustment in group styles, and shared button width animation does not itself show selected padding changes.
